newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- ASM Litho restarted.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- ASM Litho restarted.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley analyst Jay Deahna said he restarted ASM Lithography Holdings NV as strong buy.
-- additional details were not immediately available.
-- Morgan Stanley later said it increased its stock price target to $100 a share from the prior target of $70 a share. Additional details on the time frame were not immediately available.

-- said the 1997 earnings estimate remains $4.40 a share and the initial 1998 estimate is $6.00 a share. Said ASM could exceed the 1998 estimate if the semiconductor industry expands volume production of 0.25-micron process technology in 1998.
